name: OmaValet
author: Scott Angel
description: Park and assign apps to Omarchy workspaces without editing Lua. Starts in the bar for quick setup, then switches between bar and Omarchy command-menu access from inside OmaValet. A parked app follows its workspace when opened. Optional login start is off by default and silent. Multiple apps per lane. Five default workspaces, extras up to 10. Existing Hyprland rules stay locked. Writes are atomic and reversible. No extra packages, sudo, or pkexec.

barWidget.description: Park apps on workspaces, then choose bar or Omarchy menu access.
